summary_en: 1,500,000 shares (2.93% of shares outstanding), ¥1,500M upper limit, ¥1,000/share price ceiling not disclosed. Execution window Jun 5 to Aug 31, 2026. Method: open-market purchase on Tokyo Stock Exchange. Rationale: capital efficiency and flexible capital allocation.
title_en: Notice regarding authorization to acquire treasury shares (share buyback framework)
translation_en_brief: Kawada Technologies' board of directors authorized on June 2, 2026 a share buyback framework under Company Law Article 156. The company will acquire up to 1,500,000 ordinary shares (2.93% of shares outstanding excluding treasury stock) for a maximum aggregate consideration of ¥1,500 million. Purchases will be executed via open-market transactions on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between June 5 and August 31, 2026. The stated purpose is to enhance capital efficiency and enable flexible capital allocation policy. As of May 31, 2026, the company held 1,144,528 treasury shares out of 51,278,102 shares outstanding (excluding treasury stock).
